name: Submarine
description: Plex-style on-the-fly subtitle search, download, and multi-format conversion (SRT, WebVTT, ASS/SSA, MicroDVD SUB, TTML) directly inside the playback subtitle menu across all platforms (Web, Desktop, Mobile, Roku, Android TV, Swiftfin, Kodi).
overview: On-demand subtitle search, download, time-shift, and multi-format conversion in the playback subtitle menu.

versions.changelog: Initial release of Submarine with Universal Virtual Subtitle Streams, multi-format subtitle converter (SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA, SUB, TTML), and Plex-style Web/JMP/Mobile player modal.
